data.one_liner: CLI tool that checks test coverage only on lines added in a pull request
data.what_it_does: It parses an lcov.info file and a git diff, then reports how many new lines are uncovered and whether thresholds are met. The output can be plain CLI or Markdown for PR comments.
use_when: You want to enforce coverage on new code in a PR
You need a CI step that fails when new lines are not tested
You prefer a diff‑based coverage metric over overall project coverage
avoid_when: You need coverage for the entire codebase, not just new lines
You are working on a non‑Dart project
strengths: Diff‑based coverage focuses on new code
Supports Markdown output for PR comments
Can be run as a global binary or in CI scripts
weaknesses: Only works with lcov.info from Flutter or coverage package
No integration with IDEs or test runners
data.setup_notes: Run `flutter test --coverage` to generate lcov.info, then pipe `git diff` into the tool. No build_runner or permissions needed.
data.minimal_example:
```bash
git diff origin/main | flutter pub run pull_request_coverage --maximum-uncovered-lines 5
```
